verdict: Leads slipped this week; cost per lead rising and being addressed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 175 leads at $12.35 each, all from Meta, with $2,160.84 in total ad spend. In the most recent 7 days, leads dropped 18.75% and cost per lead rose 18.76% on essentially flat spend — a pattern consistent with creative fatigue on the single active campaign. Google Business Profile activity also fell 25% week-over-week and organic search clicks dropped 23%, which points to some softening in demand broadly, not a paid-ads-only issue. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to counter fatigue, and the GBP posting cadence is being brought current to support organic visibility. The pipeline also shows 31 leads that entered through ads but do not yet appear as active opportunities in the CRM — that intake gap is being closed so no lead goes unworked.

watch_item.issue: Cost per lead is rising week-over-week as the active campaign shows signs of creative fatigue.
watch_item.fix: Ad creative is being refreshed this week and a retargeting audience is being loaded to broaden reach and bring cost per lead back down.
